# tinymce-rails

**Tag**: web

## 简介

Seamlessly integrates TinyMCE into the Rails asset pipeline introduced in Rails 3.1.

- 主页: https://github.com/spohlenz/tinymce-rails
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/tinymce-rails/8.9.0
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/tinymce-rails
